transcript.text: Could you use a clear frame from the attached clip to make a thumbnail for me, and pick the frame yourself rather than having me choose one? I’m hoping this will make the video feel a little more inviting when people first come across it. What I need is a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail, with me kept recognisable and the exact words “MORNINGS MADE EASY” in big letters beside my face. I always get a bit nervous about how I’ll look in a still pulled from a video. Please make the thumbnail warm and upbeat.

Your 16:9 thumbnail is ready:
https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbhtxeb04f9gq01ny5e5f57/output.png?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T022220Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-
(The link works for 24 hours, so please save the file.)

How I made it:
- My tools can't pull a full still frame out of a video. Instead I ran face detection on your clip. It gave me one clean, sharp crop of your face from the video, and I used that crop as the reference. So I didn't compare frames to find the best one; the face detector chose the frame.
- From that reference I built a new 16:9 image with the free model (flux-2-klein, 640px; this used 5 credits). You're on the right with a friendly, natural expression. "MORNINGS MADE EASY" is on the left in big bold white letters with a dark outline. The background is a softly blurred, sunny kitchen in warm golden morning light.

Please check two things, because I couldn't preview the image here:
- Does it still look like you? The model redraws your face from the reference, so it can drift a little.
- Is the text spelled exactly "MORNINGS MADE EASY"? AI models sometimes get letters wrong.

If either one is off, tell me and I'll make another version. I can also change the colours, layout or background.

One more limit: 640px is the highest size on the free plan, and YouTube recommends 1280×720. The image will still upload fine, but it may look a bit soft on large screens.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished 16:9 thumbnail with a download link. It adds caveats (possible face drift, text spelling check, 640px size limit) and offers to make another version, but the main content is a completed result.
